description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to networking, specifically for Ingress resources, Ingress classes, IP addresses, and CIDR ranges. It includes struct definitions, constants, and metadata annotations used for Kubernetes API version v1beta1.

classes.name: Ingress
classes.description: Represents a collection of rules that allow inbound connections to reach services within the cluster.

classes.name: IngressList
classes.description: A list of Ingress objects.

classes.name: IngressSpec
classes.description: Specifies the desired state of an Ingress, including rules, TLS settings, and ingress class.

classes.name: IngressStatus
classes.description: Current status of the Ingress, including load balancer information.

classes.name: IngressTLS
classes.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress, including hosts and secret name.

classes.name: IngressLoadBalancerStatus
classes.description: Status of the load balancer associated with the Ingress.

classes.name: IngressLoadBalancerIngress
classes.description: Represents an ingress point for the load balancer, IP or hostname, and ports.

classes.name: IngressPortStatus
classes.description: Status of a specific port on the load balancer, including protocol and error info.

classes.name: IngressRule
classes.description: Mapping of host to backend services, including rules for routing.

classes.name: IngressRuleValue
classes.description: Defines the routing rule, currently supporting HTTP rules.

classes.name: HTTPIngressRuleValue
classes.description: List of paths and backends for HTTP routing.

classes.name: HTTPIngressPath
classes.description: Associates a URL path with a backend service.

classes.name: IngressBackend
classes.description: Defines the backend service endpoints for routing traffic.

classes.name: IngressClass
classes.description: Specifies the class of ingress, used to select ingress controllers.

classes.name: IngressClassSpec
classes.description: Details about the ingress class, including controller and parameters.

classes.name: IngressClassParametersReference
classes.description: References an external resource for ingress class configuration.

classes.name: IngressClassList
classes.description: A list of ingress classes.

classes.name: IPAddress
classes.description: Represents a single IP address, with metadata and spec.

classes.name: IPAddressSpec
classes.description: Specifies the parent resource associated with the IP address.

classes.name: ParentReference
classes.description: References a parent resource, including group, resource, namespace, and name.

classes.name: IPAddressList
classes.description: A list of IPAddress objects.

classes.name: ServiceCIDR
classes.description: Defines a range of IP addresses in CIDR notation for service cluster IPs.

classes.name: ServiceCIDRSpec
classes.description: Specifies CIDRs for allocating service IPs, max two CIDRs.

classes.name: ServiceCIDRStatus
classes.description: Current status of the ServiceCIDR, including conditions.

classes.name: ServiceCIDRList
classes.description: A list of ServiceCIDR objects.
